package relationorder

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const maxOrder = 32767

// Normalize validates one complete ordered child set for a hierarchy parent.
func Normalize(parentID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) (string, []domain.CatalogRelationOrder, error) {
	parentID = strings.TrimSpace(parentID)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(parentID); err != nil || len(items) == 0 {
		return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	normalized := make([]domain.CatalogRelationOrder, 0, len(items))
	childIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	orders := make(map[int]struct{}, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		childID := strings.TrimSpace(item.ChildID)
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(childID); err != nil || item.Order < 0 || item.Order > maxOrder {
			return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := childIDs[childID]; exists {
			return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := orders[item.Order]; exists {
			return "", nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		childIDs[childID] = struct{}{}
		orders[item.Order] = struct{}{}
		normalized = append(normalized, domain.CatalogRelationOrder{ChildID: childID, Order: item.Order})
	}
	return parentID, normalized, nil
}
